extra_vocab.en: to fix or join one thing to another
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，when attaching it to the stroller 指把座椅裝到推車上，是實體零件接合的用法。講者用 attach 說明傳統裝法需要小心對準兩側，再和 Magic Connect 做比較。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: attach 最常用 attach A to B，to 是介系詞，後面接名詞；被動時用 be attached to。

example.en: The clerk attaches a label to every package before shipping.
example.zh: 店員在出貨前會在每個包裹上貼標籤。

example.en: I attached the updated schedule to this email for your review.
example.zh: 我已把更新後的時程表附在這封郵件中供你審閱。

example.en: Please see the attached file for the full price list.
example.zh: 完整價目表請見附加檔案。

example.en: Attaching the wrong cable may damage the new printer.
example.zh: 接錯纜線可能會損壞這台新印表機。

example.en: Please attach a file when you send the application form.
example.zh: 寄出申請表時，請附加一個檔案。

collocations.zh: 把 A 接到 B 上

example.en: Attach the label to the front of each box.
example.zh: 請把標籤貼在每個箱子的正面。

example.en: The attached document explains how to return a damaged item.
example.zh: 附件文件說明了如何退回受損的商品。

examples.en: I have attached the invoice, so please check the total.
examples.zh: 我已附上發票，請確認總金額。

examples.en: Workers attach the handle to the cart on the second line.
examples.zh: 工人在第二條生產線上把把手裝到推車上。

examples.en: Applicants should attach a resume and a short cover letter.
examples.zh: 應徵者應附上履歷與一封簡短的求職信。

examples.en: Many customers are attached to this brand because of its quality.
examples.zh: 許多顧客因為品質而對這個品牌有感情。

confusable.diff: attack 是「攻擊」，拼法只差一個字母，和「連接」無關。

example.en: The company said hackers tried to attack its website.
example.zh: 公司表示駭客試圖攻擊它的網站。

confusable.diff: attend 是「參加、出席」，發音開頭相近，但意思不同。

example.en: Please attend the safety training in Room 305 on Friday.
example.zh: 請在星期五參加 305 室的安全訓練。

example.en: Connect the printer to the network before the meeting starts.
example.zh: 會議開始前，請把印表機連上網路。

example.en: Please fasten the cover with two small screws first.
example.zh: 請先用兩顆小螺絲把護蓋固定好。

example.en: Join the two parts together and press down firmly.
example.zh: 把兩個零件接在一起並用力壓緊。

derived.link: attach + -ment，把動作變成名詞，像 agree → agreement
de- 表示分開、取消，像 decrease；de + attach 就是 attach 的相反
re- 表示再一次，像 rebuild；re + attach 就是重新接上

senses.en: to join one thing to another thing

example.en: Attach the strap to the bag before you ship it.
example.zh: 寄出前，請先把背帶裝到袋子上。

senses.en: to add a document to a message or form
senses.distinguish: 受詞是檔案、文件或照片時，指附在郵件或表格後面。

example.en: Please attach your passport copy to the registration form.
example.zh: 請把護照影本附在報名表上。

senses.en: to link a rule or condition to something
senses.distinguish: 受詞是條件、限制或價值時，常用被動，指附帶某些規定。

example.en: The company attaches several conditions to this special discount offer.
example.zh: 公司在這項特價優惠上附帶了幾個條件。

extra_vocab.en: to take something away from a place
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，To remove the seat 指把座椅從推車車架上拆下來。講者接著說明拆下的步驟，強調單手就能完成。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: remove A from B 是常見句型，from 是介系詞，表示把 A 從 B 拿走。

example.en: Pressing this button removes the seat from the frame in seconds.
example.zh: 按下這個按鈕，就能在幾秒內把座椅從車架上拆下。

example.en: The staff removed the old shelves before the renovation began.
example.zh: 員工在整修開始前把舊架子拆走了。

example.en: Removing the cover will cancel the product warranty.
example.zh: 拆下護蓋會使產品保固失效。

collocations.zh: 把 A 從 B 移除

example.en: Please remove the old files from the shared folder.
example.zh: 請把舊檔案從共用資料夾中移除。

example.en: This cleaner can remove a stain from the carpet quickly.
example.zh: 這款清潔劑能快速去除地毯上的污漬。

example.en: Remove the cover before you start cleaning the machine.
example.zh: 開始清潔機器前，請先拆下護蓋。

examples.en: Staff must remove damaged items from the shelves right away.
examples.zh: 員工必須立刻把受損商品從貨架上撤下。

examples.en: Please remove my name from your mailing list today.
examples.zh: 請今天就把我的名字從你們的寄送名單中刪除。

examples.en: The company removed him from the project last month.
examples.zh: 公司上個月把他從這個專案中調離。

examples.en: Workers should remove their tools from the area after work.
examples.zh: 工人下班後應把工具從該區域拿走。

confusable.diff: move 是「移動」到別處，remove 是把東西「拿走、拆掉」。

example.en: Please move the boxes to the new storage room.
example.zh: 請把箱子搬到新的儲藏室。

confusable.diff: replace 是換上新的東西，remove 只是拿掉，不一定補新的。

example.en: The technician will replace the broken part tomorrow morning.
example.zh: 技術人員明天早上會更換損壞的零件。

example.en: Please delete the old photos from the company tablet.
example.zh: 請把舊照片從公司平板上刪除。

example.en: We should eliminate unnecessary steps in this process.
example.zh: 我們應該消除這個流程中不必要的步驟。

example.en: Detach the lower part of the form and keep it.
example.zh: 請撕下表格的下半部並自行保留。

derived.link: remove + -al，把動作變成名詞，像 arrive → arrival

senses.en: to take something away from where it is

example.en: Please remove the battery before you ship the device.
example.zh: 寄出裝置前，請先取出電池。

senses.en: to delete information from a file or system
senses.distinguish: 受詞是檔案、名字或資料時，指刪掉內容。

example.en: The system will remove old files after thirty days.
example.zh: 系統會在三十天後清除舊檔案。

senses.en: to make someone leave a job or position
senses.distinguish: 受詞是人、後面接 from a position 時，指免除職務。

example.en: The board voted to remove the manager from his position.
example.zh: 董事會投票決定免除這位經理的職務。

extra_vocab.en: the part of a seat that supports your back
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，backrest tube 指座椅椅背的骨架管，拆下座椅時要轉動它頂端的按鈕。講者也用 rotate the backrest、fold the seat backrest 說明調整與摺疊椅背的步驟。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: backrest 是可數名詞，寫成一個字，單數前要加 a 或 the。

example.en: All the new chairs have adjustable backrests for better comfort.
example.zh: 所有新椅子都有可調整的椅背，坐起來更舒適。

example.en: Choose an adjustable backrest if you sit for long hours.
example.zh: 如果你久坐，請選擇可調整椅背。

example.en: The padded backrest makes long meetings more comfortable.
example.zh: 有軟墊的椅背讓冗長的會議更舒適。

example.en: Press this lever to lower the backrest to a flat position.
example.zh: 按下這個拉桿，就能把椅背放到平躺的位置。

examples.en: Our office chairs come with a high backrest and soft cushion.
examples.zh: 我們的辦公椅附有高椅背與柔軟的坐墊。

examples.en: The supplier will replace the broken backrest at no cost.
examples.zh: 供應商會免費更換損壞的椅背。

examples.en: Please return your backrest to the upright position before landing.
examples.zh: 降落前，請將您的椅背調回直立位置。

examples.en: The backrest folds forward so the seat can be stored easily.
examples.zh: 椅背可向前摺疊，讓座椅方便收納。

confusable.diff: footrest 是放腳的踏板，backrest 是支撐背部的椅背。

example.en: The footrest on this chair lifts up for a short break.
example.zh: 這張椅子的腳踏板可以抬起，方便短暫休息。

confusable.diff: armrest 是手臂靠的扶手，backrest 是靠背的部分。

example.en: Please keep your bag off the armrest during the flight.
example.zh: 飛行期間，請不要把包包放在扶手上。

example.en: Adjust the headrest so it fits your neck comfortably.
example.zh: 請調整頭枕，讓它舒適地貼合你的頸部。

example.en: Add a cushion to the chair for extra comfort.
example.zh: 在椅子上加一個坐墊會更舒服。

example.en: The metal frame holds the seat firmly in place.
example.zh: 金屬車架能把座椅牢牢固定在定位。

extra_vocab.en: standing straight up and not leaning or lying down
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，the upright position 指把椅背轉到垂直直立的位置。結尾的 stands upright on its own 則是副詞用法，表示推車摺疊後能自己站直。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: upright 當形容詞放在名詞前（an upright position），當副詞放在動詞後（stand upright、sit upright）。

example.en: Please keep your seat in the upright position during takeoff.
example.zh: 起飛期間，請將您的座椅保持在直立位置。

example.en: The new cabinet can stand upright without any extra support.
example.zh: 這個新櫃子不需要額外支撐就能直立站著。

example.en: Sit upright to avoid back pain during long meetings.
example.zh: 開長會時要坐直，才能避免背痛。

example.en: Please keep the boxes upright during shipping to prevent leaks.
example.zh: 運送期間請讓箱子保持直立，以免漏液。

examples.en: Store the bottles upright so that the liquid does not spill.
examples.zh: 請把瓶子直立存放，以免液體灑出來。

examples.en: This vacuum cleaner stands upright, so it takes little floor space.
examples.zh: 這台吸塵器可以直立放置，所以佔地很小。

examples.en: Doctors suggest sitting upright when you work at a desk.
examples.zh: 醫師建議在書桌前工作時要坐直。

confusable.diff: upset 是「心煩的、不高興的」，只是開頭 up- 相同，和直立無關。

example.en: The customer was upset about the late delivery.
example.zh: 顧客對延遲送貨感到不高興。

confusable.diff: upward 指「向上的方向」，upright 指「直立的狀態」。

example.en: Sales showed an upward trend in the last quarter.
example.zh: 上一季的銷售呈現向上的趨勢。

example.en: The poster should hang in a vertical position on the wall.
example.zh: 這張海報應該垂直掛在牆上。

example.en: Please keep the line straight when you draw the chart.
example.zh: 畫圖表時，請把線條畫直。

example.en: Lay the box flat so that it fits on the shelf.
example.zh: 把箱子平放，這樣才放得進架子。

example.en: The manual shows the product in an upright position.
example.zh: 說明書中展示的是產品直立的樣子。

example.en: Please hold the tablet upright while you scan the code.
example.zh: 掃描代碼時，請把平板拿直。

example.en: Keep the display in an upright position during the exhibition.
example.zh: 展覽期間，請讓展示架保持直立。

senses.en: honest and fair in the way you act
senses.distinguish: 形容人的品格時指正直誠實；形容物品或姿勢時指直立。

example.en: He is an upright manager who always tells the truth.
example.zh: 他是一位總是說實話的正直經理。

extra_vocab.en: full of people or things with little space left
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，especially in crowded spaces 指商場、街道等人多又擁擠的地方。講者說明橫向移動功能在這種狹窄的空間特別好用。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: crowded 常用 be crowded with + 人或物；表示「擁擠的」要用 crowded，不能寫成 a crowd street。

example.en: Large crowds gathered outside the store on opening day.
example.zh: 開幕當天，大批人潮聚集在店外。

example.en: Heavy traffic crowds the main road every morning.
example.zh: 每天早上，大量車流塞滿主要道路。

example.en: Customers are crowding the entrance to get free samples.
example.zh: 顧客擠在入口處想拿免費試用品。

example.en: The conference hall was crowded with eager visitors.
example.zh: 會議廳裡擠滿了熱切的訪客。

example.en: Crowded streets made it hard for the delivery van to move.
example.zh: 擁擠的街道讓送貨車很難前進。

example.en: My crowded schedule leaves no time for lunch this week.
example.zh: 我這週行程太滿，連吃午餐的時間都沒有。

example.en: The restaurant can get crowded on Friday evenings, so reserve early.
example.zh: 這家餐廳星期五晚上可能很擁擠，請提早訂位。

examples.en: The restaurant was too crowded, so we waited outside.
examples.zh: 餐廳太擁擠，所以我們在外面等。

examples.en: Avoid the crowded subway by leaving before eight o'clock.
examples.zh: 八點前出發，就能避開擁擠的地鐵。

examples.en: The exhibition hall was crowded on the last day.
examples.zh: 展覽館在最後一天非常擁擠。

examples.en: Our crowded office has no space for extra desks.
examples.zh: 我們擁擠的辦公室沒有空間再放多餘的桌子。

confusable.diff: cloudy 是「多雲的」，拼法與 crowd 相近，但和人多擁擠無關。

example.en: It will be cloudy, so the outdoor event may be moved.
example.zh: 天氣會是多雲，所以戶外活動可能會改期。

example.en: The airport is busy because of the holiday season.
example.zh: 因為假期旺季，機場非常繁忙。

example.en: The hall was packed with people waiting for the speech.
example.zh: 大廳裡擠滿了等著聽演講的人。

example.en: The congested highway delayed our shipment by two hours.
example.zh: 壅塞的高速公路使我們的貨物延誤了兩個小時。

derived.link: over- 表示太過，像 overtime；over + crowded 就是擠得太過頭
overcrowd + -ing，把「過度擁擠」這件事變成名詞，像 meeting
un- 表示不，像 unclear、unusual；un + crowded 就是不擁擠

example.en: Please avoid the crowded areas near the main entrance.
example.zh: 請避開主要入口附近的擁擠區域。

example.en: A large crowd waited outside for the product launch.
example.zh: 一大群人在外面等著產品發表會。

example.en: Visitors began to crowd around the new display.
example.zh: 訪客開始圍擠在新展示品周圍。

senses.en: to fill a place so that there is little space left

example.en: Shoppers crowded the mall on the first day of the sale.
example.zh: 特賣第一天，購物者擠滿了購物中心。

senses.en: to move close together in a small space
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 into、around，指人們擠進或圍在某處。

example.en: Everyone crowded into the small room to hear the news.
example.zh: 大家擠進小房間聽消息。

extra_vocab.en: to bend something so that one part covers another part
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡，how to fold the stroller 指把推車收合成較小的體積。講者還提到座椅會 folds down under its own weight，也就是靠自身重量自動收合。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: fold 可以是及物（fold the stroller），也可以是不及物（The seat folds down）；表示「可摺疊的」可用 foldable 或 can be folded。

example.en: This table folds flat, so it fits in a small closet.
example.zh: 這張桌子可以摺平，所以放得進小衣櫃。

example.en: She folded the brochures and put them in an envelope.
example.zh: 她把手冊摺好，放進信封裡。

example.en: The folded stroller fits easily in the trunk of a car.
example.zh: 摺疊後的推車很容易放進汽車後車廂。

example.en: Folding the chairs takes less than a minute.
example.zh: 把椅子收起來不到一分鐘。

example.en: Please fold up the tables after the workshop ends.
example.zh: 工作坊結束後，請把桌子收起來。

example.en: Fold the sheet in half before you put it in the envelope.
example.zh: 把紙對摺後再放進信封。

example.en: We need ten more folding chairs for tomorrow's training session.
example.zh: 明天的訓練課程還需要十張折疊椅。

examples.en: Please fold the letter twice before putting it in the envelope.
examples.zh: 把信放進信封前，請先摺兩次。

examples.en: This jacket folds into a small bag for easy travel.
examples.zh: 這件外套可以摺進小袋子，方便旅行攜帶。

examples.en: The company folded last year because of rising costs.
examples.zh: 這家公司去年因為成本上升而倒閉了。

examples.en: Fold the cover back, and then press the green button.
examples.zh: 把護蓋向後摺，然後按下綠色按鈕。

confusable.diff: hold 是「握住、拿著」，拼法與發音都像 fold，但沒有摺疊的意思。

example.en: Please hold the door open for the delivery staff.
example.zh: 請替送貨人員把門撐開。

confusable.diff: fall 是「下降、掉落」，拼法與發音相近，意思不同。

example.en: Prices may fall if demand stays low this season.
example.zh: 如果這一季需求持續低迷，價格可能會下降。

example.en: Do not bend the cable too much when you store it.
example.zh: 收納纜線時，請不要過度彎折。

example.en: Wrap each glass in paper before you pack the box.
example.zh: 裝箱前，請用紙把每個玻璃杯包好。

example.en: Staff pack the folded shirts into boxes every afternoon.
example.zh: 員工每天下午把摺好的襯衫裝進箱子。

derived.link: un- 表示相反，像 unlock、undo；un + fold 就是把摺好的打開
fold + -er，指摺起來用來裝文件的東西，像 printer

example.en: Please fold the banner carefully before you store it.
example.zh: 收起橫幅之前，請小心地把它摺好。

example.en: The poster has a deep fold across the middle.
example.zh: 這張海報中間有一道很深的摺痕。

senses.en: to bend something so that it takes less space

example.en: You can fold the stand and carry it in a bag.
example.zh: 你可以把支架收合後放進袋子裡帶走。

senses.en: if a business folds, it closes because it has no money
senses.distinguish: 主詞是公司或店家時，指經營不善而倒閉。

example.en: The small shop folded after sales dropped sharply.
example.zh: 這家小店在銷售量大幅下滑後倒閉了。
